entities.summary: "Angel Kanchev" University of Ruse is a public university in the city of Ruse, Bulgaria. The university was formed on 21 July 1995 by the dissolution of Higher Institute of Mechanical Engineering, Mechanisation and Electrification of Agriculture which was commonly known as with establishment date 12 November 1945. This was the first national higher technical school outside the Bulgarian capital.
